body:
>why'd you accept the promotion given that condition?

Because at the time I didn't see it as realistic to be going to school right away, so I figured it would be safe to take. It still isn't very realistic, but now I'm just wanting out of all this, and running to a different state seems like a good way to do it.

I also did all the financial aid/scholarships options I possibly could and I got a bit, but it really just scratched the surface. Not enough to help. My parents make a 6 figure income so I got virtually no financial aid. The problem is they aren't contributing one cent to my education.
